thread:
nadia_marketing: Heads up  eu-west embeddings had a recurring 5xx + latency spike earlier (~25m). Oncall pushed traffic to a compatibility fallback and started a rollback. Need short status copy + a decision on whether to offer a customer webinar for affected accounts.

Tom_oncall: Confirmed. Root cause: regression in v2.3.1 quantized runtime causing KV-cache overflow under certain sequence patterns. Mitigation: rollback to v2.3.0 + recompile. Canary started at 18:50 UTC, initial canary looks clean. ETA for full rollout ~45 minutes. No customer data exposure.

greg_support: Seeing an uptick in tickets from eu-west customers. Most are "intermittent 5xx" and "slower embeddings". A few high-volume customers asked for SLA credit.

nadia_marketing: For the status page, propose short machine-readable copy + human line. Keep concise. Also, we should prepare a 30-min technical webinar invite for enterprise customers to explain what happened and prevention steps. Offer a small credit as goodwill? Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jules_eng: Webinar sounds fine but keep it invite-only for the top impacted orgs. We should have the eng lead present (can do postmortem + Q&A). I'd recommend credit: one week free on next month's bill or 10% credit for impacted customers. Need legal OK.

sarah_csm: +1 to invite-only. I'll draft targeted invites for the ~9 affected orgs and prioritize the top 4 who saw errors >5% of requests. Credits: most customers want quick remediation or an SLA conversation; a small credit is usually appreciated and reduces churn risk.

statusbot: Incident created  INC-2028-935  severity: medium  owner: runtime-team  link: https://internal.status.redwood/INC-2028-935

nadia_marketing: Draft statuspage text (short + details):

```
Status: Degraded performance (Embeddings  eu-west)
Short summary: A subset of embedding requests to eu-west intermittently returned errors or experienced elevated latency. Oncall rerouted traffic to a compatible fallback model and initiated a rollback to restore service.
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and latency spikes for embeddings in eu-west.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback; rollback to v2.3.0 in progress and validating via canary.
ETA: Canary validation underway; expected resolution within ~45 minutes.
Customer guidance: Retry failed requests or configure client-side retry/backoff. Contact support@redwood.ai or your CSM for account-specific impact.
```

nadia_marketing: Short headline: "Embeddings (eu-west): degraded  rollback in progress"

Tom_oncall: wording ok. Add "no customer data exposure" to the human-facing line.

nadia_marketing: Updated. For the webinar: propose a 30-min technical briefing + 15-min optional 1:1 office hours after. Draft invite copy in thread below.

sarah_csm: Please include timeline and what changes we're making to prevent recurrence in the webinar. Also offer a 1:1 for any team that wants a walk-through.

nadia_marketing: Webinar invite draft:

"We experienced an embeddings disruption in eu-west due to a runtime regression affecting certain request patterns. We would like to invite your engineering leads to a brief technical briefing where our runtime and product teams will walk through the cause, rollback actions taken, and long-term mitigations. There will be a short Q&A and optional office hours for affected customers."

greg_support: Add: "If you'd prefer a private postmortem, reply and we'll schedule a 1:1."

jules_eng: I can present the timeline and technical remediation. We should be transparent about the version numbers and the fix (rollback + improved unit/regression tests).

nadia_marketing: Credits: propose a standard one-week service credit for accounts with >2% error rate during the window, and discretionary credits for top 3 impacted customers. Sarah/greg to confirm exact list and run by finance/legal.

sarah_csm: I'll compile the impacted list and flag the top 3. Will coordinate with finance for approval on credits.

Tom_oncall: Canary looks good at 19:12 UTC. Starting progressive rollout now. Will update status when rollout completes.

statusbot: Status updated  INC-2028-935  state: Degraded  link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2028-935

nadia_marketing: Plan for outbound comms timing:
- 0m: Post "degraded" on status page (done).
- +45m: If rollout succeeds -> update status to "partial recovery" and notify impacted CSMs; schedule webinar invites for next week (invite-only).
- +2h: If unresolved or rollback shows issues -> send proactive interim email to impacted customers with next steps and offer office hours.

greg_support: Also prepare canned responses for support tickets and internal slack snippets for CSMs so they can reply quickly.

nadia_marketing: I'll draft canned responses and the targeted webinar invites. Sarah/greg, please share the impacted org list when ready.

jules_eng: FYI we'll add extra regression tests for the KV-cache patterns to our CI and schedule a short audit of quantized runtime changes.

sarah_csm: Sharing the impacted list in DMs now.

nadia_marketing: Thanks team. Reconvene in 30m for a rollout status update. :pray:
